verdicts.tldr: no test reads NewHTMLRenderer's warning, so putting the gateway value back on it stays green
verdicts.details: TestNewHTMLRendererIPFSGateway (ipfs_test.go:141-158) passes log.NewTestingLogger(t) and asserts only the rendered src; the s3cret loop at ipfs_test.go:117-132 calls NewRouter alone. Reach: NewHTMLRenderer's only in-tree caller is NewRouter (app.go:214), which hands it an already-normalized gateway, so the warning fires for out-of-tree callers of the exported constructor only. A paste-ready test capturing the slog output passes at head and fails under the mutation.
verdicts.evidence: mutation render.go:98 -> logger.Warn("ignoring invalid IPFS gateway", "gateway", cfg.IPFSGateway, "error", err); go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run IPFS -count=1: ok (green). tests/judge-1-renderer-warn-redaction_test.go: ok at head; under the mutation FAIL, "... gateway=https://user:s3cret@gw.example error=\"must not contain credentials\"" should not contain "s3cret"
verdicts.verify_by: mutate render.go:98 to echo cfg.IPFSGateway; go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run IPFS -count=1: expect red, observe green

verdicts.tldr: the eight secret-bearing shapes run through NewRouter only; the renderer's own warning has no test
verdicts.details: grep -rn s3cret over *_test.go in gno.land and contribs: gnoweb hits only in the NewRouter loop of TestNewRouterIPFSGateway, the rest in indexer/client_test.go and omnisearch/handler_test.go. Same mutation, same green run; the judge's test reddens it.
verdicts.evidence: grep -rn s3cret --include='*_test.go' gno.land contribs: ipfs_test.go NewRouter loop, indexer/client_test.go:537-592, omnisearch/handler_test.go:320; mutation run: ok
verdicts.verify_by: mutate render.go:98; go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run IPFS -count=1; grep -rn s3cret gno.land contribs --include='*_test.go'

verdicts.tldr: -ipfs-gateway help says only ipfs:// and retired-gateway URLs are rewritten, though URLs on ipfs.filebase.io are rewritten too
verdicts.details: ext_ipfs.go adds "ipfs.filebase.io": false to ipfsRewrittenGateways, so an operator who moves -ipfs-gateway off Filebase has every stored ipfs.filebase.io URL sent to the new gateway. The help at main.go:241, gnodev's -web-ipfs-gateway help (contribs/gnodev/app_config.go:152, README.md:113) and the godocs at ipfs.go:13-15 and markdown/context.go:24 name only retired gateways; docs/users/explore-with-gnoweb.md and the ADR were updated.
verdicts.evidence: sed -n 241p main.go: "IPFS gateway origin that ipfs:// URLs and retired gateway URLs (ipfs.io, dweb.link, ...) are rewritten to; empty disables the rewrite"; grep -rn 'retired gateway' hits app_config.go:152, README.md:113, context.go:24; ext_ipfs.go "ipfs.filebase.io": false, // gnoweb.DefaultIPFSGateway
verdicts.verify_by: grep -rn 'retired gateway URLs' gno.land/cmd/gnoweb/main.go contribs/gnodev: expect no hit after the fix

verdicts.tldr: NewDefaultAppConfig clones DefaultAliases, so the test's alias write touches its own map
verdicts.details: The removed maps.Clone was redundant: app.go:140 already clones for every caller, and a -race run of the router tests is clean.
verdicts.evidence: app.go:140 Aliases: maps.Clone(DefaultAliases), // callers add their own; go test -race ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run 'TestNewRouter|TestNewDefault|Alias' -count=1: ok 45.920s, no DATA RACE

verdicts.tldr: the RawPath guard is pinned: dropping it reddens TestRewriteIPFSURL
verdicts.details: Go's url.setPath keeps the raw path in RawPath even when it is not a valid encoding, so the guard compares against the original %41<cid> name; the untouched case in ext_ipfs_test.go catches its removal.
verdicts.evidence: ext_ipfs.go:150 -> if false && u.RawPath != "" {; go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown -run IPFS -count=1: FAIL TestRewriteIPFSURL, expected "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/%41bafy.../a b.png" to be left alone, got "https://gw.test/ipfs/Abafy.../a%20b.png"
verdicts.refuted_by: ext_ipfs_test.go untouched case "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/%41" + testCIDv1 + "/a b.png" turns red without the guard
verdicts.verify_by: change ext_ipfs.go:150 to if false && u.RawPath != "" {; go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown -run IPFS -count=1

verdicts.tldr: the redaction holds: url.Parse's error is replaced and pinned, and no other log or error line prints the gateway
verdicts.details: Reverting ipfs.go:46 to return the url.Parse error reddens three of the eight secret shapes; a sweep of non-test Go files for the gateway setting inside log, print or Errorf calls finds none.
verdicts.evidence: ipfs.go:46 -> return "", err: FAIL TestNewRouterIPFSGateway, "invalid IPFS gateway: parse \"https://user:s3cret^x@gw.example\": net/url: invalid userinfo" should not contain "s3cret" (also the :s3cret port and the backslash host shapes); grep sweep: no hit
verdicts.refuted_by: ipfs.go:46 return "", errors.New("not a valid URL"), pinned by the s3cret loop in TestNewRouterIPFSGateway
verdicts.verify_by: revert ipfs.go:46 to return "", err; go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestNewRouterIPFSGateway -count=1; grep sweep for the gateway in log, print and Errorf calls
